name: superior-discord-bot
description: Multi-server utility and moderation runtime for Superior

scripts.check: npm run version:verify && npm run docs:links && npm run powershell:check && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run version:generate && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.security:check: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm ls --all && node ../scripts/security-check.mjs && npm run test:security
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run release:build
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run release:build
scripts.release:major: npm run version:major && npm run release:build
scripts.test:security: vitest run tests/ticket-authorization.test.ts tests/storage-multitenancy.test.ts tests/storage-backup.test.ts tests/persistent-panel-compatibility.test.ts tests/interaction-lifecycle.test.ts tests/logging-errors.test.ts tests/windows-packaging.test.ts
